upstream.description: Personal AI desktop agent for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android & iOS. Set a goal, it works on its own. Teams (pair two desktops, agents + humans), Agent2Agent, Workflows, Codework, multi-agent orgs, desktop + browser automation. 15+ AI providers, BYOK. No Docker, no terminal. Agent Skills (SKILL.md). Migration importer. Recurring autonomous tasks.

classification.analysis: Skales is a closed-source, cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android/iOS) personal AI desktop agent with a free built-in trial or BYOK across 15+ providers, offline Ollama support, and features spanning chat, a coding mode with inline diffs, an image/video/design studio, desktop automation, and agent-to-agent pairing between devices. This GitHub repo is only the distribution/release channel (changelog, installers, issue tracker) plus a stale historical v7 source snapshot under a source-available BSL 1.1 license; the actual shipped app is closed source and not built from this repo. Aimed at non-technical end users wanting a local, low-friction AI agent rather than developers wanting to build from source.

use_cases.title: Install a no-terminal local AI agent for everyday tasks
Bind a folder to chat for AI-assisted coding with diffs
Pair a phone to control a desktop agent remotely
